question: How often does a bounded public-x search lift subgroup points to the fixed rational curve, and which short two-point relations survive?
fields: all eight selected fields in input order
subgroup_generator: m times reduction of (2,2), m=ord((2,2) mod p)/q
target: Q=17G, fixture scalar used only for replay
query_law: complete t in [0,q), R_t=Q-tG; pair law is independent ordered t1,t2 in [0,q)^2

lift_rule.acceptance: first candidate with x^3-x-2 a nonnegative integer square and integer y sign reducing to public y
lift_rule.probe_charge: each inspected candidate x, including negative values and failed squares

relation_family: all ordered (a,b) with 1<=a<=3, 1<=abs(b)<=3, gcd(a,abs(b))=1; lexicographic a,b
raw_rows: one deterministic gzip JSONL file per field, including every failed point lift
claim_boundary: public-coordinate fixed-window lift yield and short-relation diagnostics; no timing or claim of complete rational lifting
